      Here is a complete, production-ready, and highly professional HTML and CSS template for your YouTube thumbnail selling business.
      It features a dark-themed premium design (popular in the creator economy), a clean portfolio grid, pricing tiers, and an automated WhatsApp checkout system that routes directly to your phone number (9989495213).
      How to use this:
      1. Copy the code below.

      <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>ClickCraft | Professional YouTube Thumbnails</title>
    <style>
        /* Modern Reset and CSS Variables */
        :root {
            --bg-color: #0b0f19;
            --card-bg: #111827;
            --accent-color: #ff4757;
            --accent-hover: #e84118;
            --text-main: #f3f4f6;
            --text-muted: #9ca3af;
            --whatsapp-green: #25d366;
            --font-stack: 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            font-family: var(--font-stack);
            background-color: var(--bg-color);
            color: var(--text-main);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        /* Header Navigation */
        header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 20px 8%;
            background-color: rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.8);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 100;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #1f2937;
        }

        .logo {
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .logo span {
            color: var(--accent-color);
        }

        nav a {
            color: var(--text-main);
            text-decoration: none;
            margin-left: 20px;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: color 0.3s;
        }

        nav a:hover {
            color: var(--accent-color);
        }

        /* Hero Section */
        .hero {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 100px 20px 80px 20px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at top, #1e293b 0%, var(--bg-color) 70%);
        }

        .hero h1 {
            font-size: 3.5rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.2;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            max-width: 800px;
        }

        .hero h1 span {
            color: var(--accent-color);
        }

        .hero p {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            max-width: 600px;
            margin-bottom: 40px;
        }

        .cta-btn {
            background-color: var(--accent-color);
            color: white;
            padding: 15px 35px;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-decoration: none;
            border-radius: 50px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(255, 71, 87, 0.4);
            transition: transform 0.3s, background-color 0.3s;
        }

        .cta-btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            background-color: var(--accent-hover);
        }

        /* Features Section */
        .features {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));
            gap: 30px;
            padding: 60px 8%;
        }

        .feature-card {
            background-color: var(--card-bg);
            padding: 30px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            border: 1px solid #1f2937;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .feature-card h3 {
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            font-size: 1.3rem;
        }

        .feature-card p {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.95rem;
        }

        /* Portfolio Section */
        .portfolio {
            padding: 80px 8%;
        }

        .section-title {
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 2.2rem;
            margin-bottom: 50px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .section-title span {
            color: var(--accent-color);
        }

        .portfolio-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr));
            gap: 30px;
        }

        .portfolio-item {
            background-color: var(--card-bg);
            border-radius: 12px;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: 1px solid #1f2937;
            transition: transform 0.3s;
        }

        .portfolio-item:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
        }

        .thumb-placeholder {
            width: 100%;
            height: 200px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1f2937, #374151);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-weight: bold;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
        }

        /* Replace the placeholder div with real images later like: <img src="your-image.jpg" alt="Thumbnail"> */
        .portfolio-item img {
            width: 100%;
            height: auto;
            display: block;
        }

        .portfolio-info {
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .portfolio-info tag {
            background-color: rgba(255, 71, 87, 0.2);
            color: var(--accent-color);
            padding: 4px 10px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .portfolio-info h4 {
            margin-top: 10px;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
        }

        /* Pricing Section */
        .pricing {
            padding: 80px 8%;
            background-color: rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.5);
        }

        .pricing-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
            gap: 30px;
            max-width: 1000px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .price-card {
            background-color: var(--card-bg);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 40px 30px;
            text-align: center;
            border: 1px solid #1f2937;
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: space-between;
        }

        .price-card.popular {
            border-color: var(--accent-color);
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }

        .badge {
            position: absolute;
            top: 15px;
            right: 15px;
            background-color: var(--accent-color);
            color: white;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            border-radius: 20px;
        }

        .price-card h3 {
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .price {
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            margin: 20px 0;
            color: white;
        }

        .price span {
            font-size: 1rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-weight: 400;
        }

        .features-list {
            list-style: none;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
            text-align: left;
        }

        .features-list li {
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
        }

        .features-list li::before {
            content: "✓";
            color: var(--accent-color);
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-right: 10px;
        }

        .order-btn {
            background-color: var(--whatsapp-green);
            color: white;
            padding: 12px 25px;
            text-decoration: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: 600;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 8px;
            transition: opacity 0.3s;
        }

        .order-btn:hover {
            opacity: 0.9;
        }

        /* Footer */
        footer {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 40px 20px;
            border-top: 1px solid #1f2937;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }

        /* Responsive UI Adjustments */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .hero h1 { font-size: 2.2rem; }
            header { flex-direction: column; gap: 15px; }
            nav a { margin: 0 10px; }
            .price-card.popular { transform: scale(1); }
        }
    </style>
</head>

          The 404 NOT FOUND error appears because Vercel cannot find your index.html file. 
          When Vercel builds a website, it automatically looks for a main file named exactly index.html in the root directory (the main folder) of your project. If it doesn't see it, it shows a "This page doesn't exist" error, even though your deployment was successful. 
          Here are the most common reasons and how you can fix it: 
          1. Wrong File Name
          Make sure your HTML file is named exactly index.html in all lowercase letters. 
          • If it is named thumbnail.html, main.html, or Index.html (with a capital I), Vercel will not load it as the homepage. Rename it to index.html and redeploy. 
          2. File Inside a Subfolder
          If your index.html is placed inside another folder (like a folder named website or src), Vercel won't see it right away. 
          • Fix A: Move the index.html file out of any folders so it sits directly in the main (root) folder of your project.
          • Fix B: Alternatively, if you want to keep it in a folder, go to your Vercel Dashboard, open this project, go to Settings, and change the Output Directory or Root Directory to match your folder name. 
          3. Forgot to Commit/Upload
          If you are deploying from a GitHub repository, double-check your GitHub page online to ensure the index.html file actually got pushed and is visible in your repository. 
          To help you fix this quickly, could you let me know:
          • How did you upload the project? (Did you drag-and-drop files onto Vercel, or did you link a GitHub repository?)
          • What is the current name of your HTML file?

              <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>ClickCraft | Professional YouTube Thumbnails</title>
    <style>
        /* Modern Reset and CSS Variables */
        :root {
            --bg-color: #0b0f19;
            --card-bg: #111827;
            --accent-color: #ff4757;
            --accent-hover: #e84118;
            --text-main: #f3f4f6;
            --text-muted: #9ca3af;
            --whatsapp-green: #25d366;
            --font-stack: 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            font-family: var(--font-stack);
            background-color: var(--bg-color);
            color: var(--text-main);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        /* Header Navigation */
        header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 20px 8%;
            background-color: rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.8);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 100;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #1f2937;
        }

        .logo {
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .logo span {
            color: var(--accent-color);
        }

        nav a {
            color: var(--text-main);
            text-decoration: none;
            margin-left: 20px;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: color 0.3s;
        }

        nav a:hover {
            color: var(--accent-color);
        }

        /* Hero Section */
        .hero {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 100px 20px 80px 20px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at top, #1e293b 0%, var(--bg-color) 70%);
        }

        .hero h1 {
            font-size: 3.5rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.2;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            max-width: 800px;
        }

        .hero h1 span {
            color: var(--accent-color);
        }

        .hero p {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            max-width: 600px;
            margin-bottom: 40px;
        }

        .cta-btn {
            background-color: var(--accent-color);
            color: white;
            padding: 15px 35px;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-decoration: none;
            border-radius: 50px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(255, 71, 87, 0.4);
            transition: transform 0.3s, background-color 0.3s;
        }

        .cta-btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            background-color: var(--accent-hover);
        }

        /* Features Section */
        .features {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));
            gap: 30px;
            padding: 60px 8%;
        }

        .feature-card {
            background-color: var(--card-bg);
            padding: 30px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            border: 1px solid #1f2937;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .feature-card h3 {
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            font-size: 1.3rem;
        }

        .feature-card p {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.95rem;
        }

        /* Portfolio Section */
        .portfolio {
            padding: 80px 8%;
        }

        .section-title {
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 2.2rem;
            margin-bottom: 50px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .section-title span {
            color: var(--accent-color);
        }

        .portfolio-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr));
            gap: 30px;
        }

        .portfolio-item {
            background-color: var(--card-bg);
            border-radius: 12px;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: 1px solid #1f2937;
            transition: transform 0.3s;
        }

        .portfolio-item:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
        }

        .thumb-placeholder {
            width: 100%;
            height: 200px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1f2937, #374151);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-weight: bold;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
        }

        .portfolio-item img {
            width: 100%;
            height: auto;
            display: block;
        }

        .portfolio-info {
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .portfolio-info tag {
            background-color: rgba(255, 71, 87, 0.2);
            color: var(--accent-color);
            padding: 4px 10px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .portfolio-info h4 {
            margin-top: 10px;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
        }

        /* Pricing Section */
        .pricing {
            padding: 80px 8%;
            background-color: rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.5);
        }

        .pricing-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
            gap: 30px;
            max-width: 1000px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .price-card {
            background-color: var(--card-bg);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 40px 30px;
            text-align: center;
            border: 1px solid #1f2937;
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: space-between;
        }

        .price-card.popular {
            border-color: var(--accent-color);
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }

        .badge {
            position: absolute;
            top: 15px;
            right: 15px;
            background-color: var(--accent-color);
            color: white;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            border-radius: 20px;
        }

        .price-card h3 {
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .price {
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            margin: 20px 0;
            color: white;
        }

        .price span {
            font-size: 1rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-weight: 400;
        }

        .features-list {
            list-style: none;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
            text-align: left;
        }

        .features-list li {
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
        }

        .features-list li::before {
            content: "✓";
            color: var(--accent-color);
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-right: 10px;
        }

        .order-btn {
            background-color: var(--whatsapp-green);
            color: white;
            padding: 12px 25px;
            text-decoration: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: 600;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 8px;
            transition: opacity 0.3s;
        }

        .order-btn:hover {
            opacity: 0.9;
        }

        /* Footer */
        footer {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 40px 20px;
            border-top: 1px solid #1f2937;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }

        /* Responsive UI Adjustments */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .hero h1 { font-size: 2.2rem; }
            header { flex-direction: column; gap: 15px; }
            nav a { margin: 0 10px; }
            .price-card.popular { transform: scale(1); }
        }
    </style>
</head>
